quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken press release: Equipment Investment to Expand Optical Products Production (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Decided equipment investments of approximately 1.1 billion yen across the Optical Products segment in the fiscal year ending March 2027, about twice the 592 million yen of the prior year: molds for mass production of Intelli-Cross Pro data-center optical connector components and automated assembly equipment at the Matsudo headquarters; automated polishing machines and 3D inspection equipment for optical connectors at Hangzhou Seikoh Giken; a clean room at French subsidiary DATA PIXEL SAS (new leased factory in Annecy) to produce more optical connector end-face inspection equipment.
quarterly_data.figure: Approximately 1.1 billion yen (vs 592 million yen in FY ended March 2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken press release: Equipment Investment to Expand Optical Products Production (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Plans to raise production volume of components for the Intelli-Cross Pro optical connector used in hyperscale data centers in North America to five times the current level by around October 2026, and to expand optical connector polishing machine capacity to 1.5 times the prior fiscal year-end level by the end of August 2026. Production of optical transceiver components such as MT fiber arrays is up sharply at its Chinese subsidiaries; the group hired more than 200 fixed-term employees. The company says orders remain strong for optical connectors, polishing machines and inspection equipment and expects the trend to continue for the time being.
quarterly_data.figure: Intelli-Cross Pro components five times current output by around October 2026; polishing machine capacity 1.5 times by end of August 2026; more than 200 fixed-term hires
